description: Requires profile-backed paper watch ticks to evaluate a U.S. equity market calendar before scheduler execution.
required_gate_behavior: Full market holidays must classify as closed and block paper watch ticks unless --ignore-session-gate is used.
Early-close dates must override the regular-session end time before allowed-session matching.
When allowed_sessions is regular-only, a timestamp after the early close must be blocked as after_hours.
Calendar gate decisions remain paper-only and must not submit or transmit live IBKR orders.
